name: BEN_LER_BNFT_RSTRN_F
description: BEN_LER_BNFT_RSTRN_F identifies restrictions which may be imposed a person elects to enroll in a benefit in a plan or option in plan where the enrollment opportunity is the result of a specific life event. . For example, the plan may only allow a person to change up to two levels of life insurance without certification and up to five levels with proof of good health.
